svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Acquisition · Transaction · Property Management · Disposition — the full asset lifecycle, from a broker's inbound email to the sale proceeds wire. Relationships only; fields omitted.
the owned asset — carries a closed
the set is the version history
one A → many B · Lookup (1 : N) — B holds the lookup field to A
Master-Detail (1 : N) — B is owned by A and cascade-deletes with it
Not a lookup — lead conversion, or a plain Text pointer
Lead conversion — the spine of the acquisition lifecycle
Master-Detail exists in Property Management ONLY — 5 of 54 relationships (Unit__c, Rent_Step__c, Lease_Activity__c, Renewal_Activity__c, Work_Order_Activity__c). Every Acquisition, Transaction and
Disposition relationship is a Lookup, so deleting a deal or a Disposition orphans its children rather than removing them.
Column = dependency rank, parent always to the left; dashed band = module grouping within a rank. Not drawn as edges: role lookups to User (Requested_By__c, Handling_Person__c,

Owner_User__c, Logged_By__c, Legal_Owner__c, Approved_By__c…), Opportunity's four reverse "primary" pointers (Primary_LOI__c / _Underwriting__c / _Contract__c / _NDA__c) and its self-lookup Portfolio_Deal__c.
